new.name: Quill & CDC Emerger
new.description: A simple emerger with a stripped peacock quill body under thin UV resin, a squirrel blend thorax and a CDC wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film for trout rising to emerging mayflies or midges.
steps: Tie in a stripped quill and wrap a segmented body around the bend.
Coat the quill with thin UV resin or varnish.
Tie in a CDC wing on top at the thorax.
Dub a squirrel thorax and whip finish.

new.name: American Pheasant Tail
new.description: The American version of the Pheasant Tail with copper rib, pheasant tail tail, body, legs and wing case, and a peacock herl thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it anywhere mayfly nymphs live; a standard dropper.
steps: Tie in pheasant tail fibres for the tail and the copper rib.
Wrap the fibres forward for the abdomen and counter-wrap the rib.
Tie in more fibres for the wing case and wrap a peacock thorax.
Pull the wing case over, split the tips back as legs and finish.

new.name: Baby Boy Hopper
new.description: A small foam hopper with a chartreuse foam body, round rubber legs and a deer hair wing, made for late-summer hopper eats.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it along grassy banks, alone or as the top fly over a dropper.
steps: Cut a tapered foam strip and glue it to the shank, tying it down in segments.
Tie in a small deer hair wing on top.
Tie in rubber legs on each side.
Trim the foam head and finish.

new.name: Barr's Bouface
new.description: John Barr's simple black streamer with a tungsten bead, a rabbit strip tail, pearl flash, a dubbed body of rabbit fur and a marabou collar.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it with pauses; it works for trout, bass and stillwater fish.
mats: Rabbit fur dubbed from the strip
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in a rabbit strip tail with a few strands of flash.
Clip fur from the strip and dub a short body.
Wind a black marabou collar.
Dub a little rabbit fur behind the bead and finish.

new.name: Craven's Biot Emerger
new.description: A small mayfly emerger with a gold biot abdomen, an Antron wing case and legs and a grey beaver thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film or just below during small mayfly hatches.
steps: Tie in a short tail.
Wrap the biot abdomen.
Tie in the Antron and dub the thorax.
Pull the Antron over and split the tips back as legs.

new.name: Bluegill Belly Bean
new.description: A jigging panfish fly with lead eyes, a root beer flash and micro crusher leg tail, an olive Estaz body, barred legs and a dubbed head.
new.fishing_tips: Let it sink and hop it slowly near beds and cover.
steps: Tie on the lead eyes behind the bend of the jig hook.
Tie in a tail of flash and crusher legs.
Wrap an Estaz body and add legs on each side.
Dub a small head around the eyes and finish.

new.name: Casual Dress
new.description: Polly Rosborough's buggy muskrat nymph with a muskrat tail, a muskrat underfur body and collars of muskrat and black ostrich.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly as a general nymph in rivers and lakes.
mats: Muskrat fur with underfur, in a loop
steps: Tie in a short tail of muskrat guard hairs.
Dub a thick, tapered underfur body.
Spin muskrat fur in a loop and wind it as a collar.
Wrap a black ostrich herl head and finish.

new.name: Craven's Food Stamp
new.description: A marabou-bodied mayfly nymph with a copper rib, a foam wing case, a hare's mask thorax and caribou hair legs.
new.fishing_tips: Dead-drift it in riffles and runs.
steps: Tie in the wire and twist marabou into a rope.
Wrap the marabou abdomen and rib it.
Tie in the foam and dub the thorax with caribou legs on each side.
Pull the foam over and trim it short.

new.name: Chartreuse Ostrich Damsel
new.description: A bright damsel nymph with bead chain eyes and a tail and body made from one jumbo chartreuse ostrich plume, with rainbow flash.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it slowly near weed beds; the ostrich moves on every pause.
mats: Three strands of rainbow Krystal Flash
steps: Tie on the bead chain eyes.
Tie in the ostrich tips as a tail with the flash.
Wrap the ostrich stem forward as the body.
Figure-eight around the eyes and finish.

new.name: Donegal Blue
new.description: An Irish sea trout and lake fly with a fluorescent tag, a blue seal's fur body, a silver rib and a black hen hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a point fly for sea trout and lake trout in a wave.
steps: Tie a short fluorescent tag.
Tie in the rib and dub a blue body.
Rib the body.
Wind a black hen hackle and finish.

new.name: EP Adams
new.description: A durable Adams with Trigger Point fibre wings, a mixed brown and grizzly tail and hackle, and a grey beaver body.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a general mayfly dry.
steps: Tie in and divide Trigger Point fibre wings.
Tie in a mixed tail.
Dub a grey body.
Wind brown and grizzly hackles around the wings.

new.name: Flexi Worm
new.description: A simple bloodworm or sea trout worm of red Spanflex on a grub hook.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly near the bottom on lakes or in estuaries.
steps: Tie in a length of Spanflex at the eye, leaving tails at both ends.
Wrap the Spanflex in tight turns to form a segmented body.
Leave a short wiggly tail at the bend.
Tie off and whip finish.

new.name: Flounder Snack
new.description: A bottom-hugging fluke fly with large pearl dumbbell eyes, a white rabbit strip back and tail and a pearl chenille body.
new.fishing_tips: Hop it slowly along sandy bottoms for summer flounder.
steps: Tie on the dumbbell eyes so the fly rides hook up.
Tie in the rabbit strip at the bend as a tail.
Wrap a pearl chenille body forward.
Pull the rabbit strip over the top and tie it down behind the eyes.

new.name: Flying Squirrel Nymph
new.description: A bead head squirrel nymph with a wood duck tail and legs, a red squirrel abdomen, a gold rib and a darker squirrel thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a general nymph in riffles.
steps: Add the bead and wire, then tie in a wood duck tail and the rib.
Dub the abdomen and rib it.
Tie in wood duck fibres as legs on each side.
Dub a darker thorax and finish behind the bead.

new.name: Frozen Fox
new.description: A cone head streamer with a kingfisher blue arctic fox tail and a body and wing of mixed blue, pearl and silver Ice Dub.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for trout and steelhead in cold water.
mats: Steelie blue, pearl and silver Ice Dub, mixed
steps: Slide on the cone and wrap the weight, pushing it into the cone.
Tie in a long arctic fox tail.
Dub the mixed Ice Dub in a loop and wrap it forward.
Brush the Ice Dub back to blend into the tail and finish.

new.name: Galloup's Ant Acid
new.description: A caddis-style ant with a superfine body, a holographic flash rib, Micro Flex Floss legs and a short deer hair wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as an ant or small caddis in summer.
steps: Dub a rear hump and add a short tinsel rib.
Tie in a deer hair wing at the waist.
Add Flex Floss legs on each side.
Dub a front hump and finish.

new.name: Galloup's Dolly Wing Spinner
new.description: A spinner with split Coq de Leon tails, a beaver body and a poly yarn spent wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the evening spinner fall.
mats: Coq de Leon or spade hackle
steps: Tie in split tails.
Dub a slim abdomen.
Tie in a poly yarn wing across the hook with figure-eight wraps.
Dub the thorax around the wing and trim the wings to length.

new.name: Higa's S.O.S.
new.description: Spencer Higa's small black nymph with a nickel bead, a silver rib, a red tinsel wing case, a possum thorax and Krystal Flash legs.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a dropper in tailwaters.
mats: Red holo tinsel or red floss
Two strands of black Krystal Flash
steps: Slide on the bead and tie in a short tail and the rib.
Build a thread abdomen and rib it.
Tie in the wing case and legs and dub the thorax.
Pull the wing case over and finish behind the bead.

new.name: Marabou Madness
new.description: A very simple saltwater fly of marabou tail and wound marabou body with Crystal Flash, tied with fine clear mono thread.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it slowly; marabou breathes even when the fly is still.
steps: Tie in a marabou tail with a few strands of flash.
Tie in a second marabou feather by the tip.
Wind it forward as a fluffy body.
Build a small head and finish.

new.name: Ostrich Deceiver
new.description: A Deceiver with an ostrich herl tail supported by bucktail, Polar Flash, a bucktail collar and a red flash throat.
new.fishing_tips: Strip it for stripers, bass and snook; ostrich swims on the pause.
steps: Tie a sparse bucktail support at the bend.
Tie in long ostrich herls over it with Polar Flash.
Tie a bucktail collar around the shank near the eye.
Add a red flash throat and finish the head.

new.name: Rabbit's Foot Emerger
new.description: Tom Rosenbauer's emerger with an Antron shuck, a rabbit fur abdomen, a CDC hackle and a snowshoe rabbit's foot wing.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it in the film during mayfly and caddis hatches.
steps: Tie in a short Antron shuck.
Dub a rabbit fur abdomen.
Wind one turn of CDC and tie in a snowshoe wing.
Dub a small head and finish.

new.name: Roy's Special Emerger
new.description: A simple emerger with an Antron shuck, a grey superfine body, a poly yarn wing and a dun hackle.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it to risers during small mayfly hatches.
steps: Tie in a short Antron shuck.
Dub a slim body.
Tie in a short poly wing.
Wind the hackle and finish.

new.name: Craven's Soft Hackle Emerger
new.description: A soft hackle emerger with fluoro fibre tails, a beaver or muskrat body, a fluoro fibre wing and a dun hen collar.
new.fishing_tips: Swing or dead-drift it in the film.
steps: Tie in short fluoro fibre tails.
Dub a slim abdomen.
Tie in a short fluoro fibre wing and a hen hackle.
Dub a small thorax, wind the hackle and finish.

new.name: Tap's Bug
new.description: H.G. Tapply's classic hair bug: a yellow bucktail tail and a spun and trimmed yellow deer hair body.
new.fishing_tips: Pop it near weed edges and let it sit for bass.
mats: Yellow deer body hair, spun and trimmed
steps: Tie in a bucktail tail at the bend.
Spin and pack deer hair forward to the eye.
Trim the hair to a flat-faced bug shape.
Whip finish and cement.

new.name: Wood Duck Nymph
new.description: A nymph made almost entirely from one wood duck flank feather, with a gold rib and a hare's mask thorax.
new.fishing_tips: Fish it as a mayfly nymph imitation.
steps: Tie in the feather tip as a tail and the rib.
Wrap wood duck fibres for the abdomen and rib it.
Tie in fibres for the wing case and dub the thorax.
Pull the fibres over and split them back as legs.
